subject.title: Feature: configurable dateFormat (UK/US/ISO) for envelope and system-event date display

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults.dateFormat` contract for model-visible envelope and system-event timestamps, and what enum/scope should it use?
rationale: The source change is bounded, but it expands public config and changes model-visible prompt text, which repository policy treats as a product/config decision.

options.title: Accept scoped dateFormat
options.body: Add a default-ISO enum for human-facing envelope and system-event dates only, with focused schema, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep ISO-only prompt dates
options.body: Document ISO date order as intentional for sortability and avoid adding another agent-defaults config key.

options.title: Defer to broader date/time policy
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers resolve adjacent timestamp UX requests and define one cross-surface date/time display strategy.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped dateFormat
recommendation.body: Add a default-ISO enum for human-facing envelope and system-event dates only, with focused schema, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the envelope config surface and has the closest config/product history for deciding whether another agent-defaults key belongs here.
